create.name: Marisa Radha Weppner
create.bio:
Marisa Radha Weppner is a yoga and meditation teacher based in Boise, Idaho, where she runs Sage, a small studio and community space downtown. She has taught since 2002, trained as a master educator with Nosara Yoga under Don and Amba Stapleton, and holds a master's degree in transpersonal psychology. Her classes range across vinyasa, yin yoga, yoga nidra, chanting and Self-Awakening Yoga, and she also teaches Pranassage, a hands-on blend of yoga and bodywork. The name Radha was given to her by Ram Dass, and devotion and the Bhakti tradition run through much of what she offers.

Beyond Boise she teaches online through Insight Timer and Udaya, hosts the Love, Service, Wisdom podcast and has released a meditation album called Guidance. She leads morning yoga at the Ram Dass Legacy summer retreats, takes groups on pilgrimage-style retreats to the west coast of Ireland, and created Yogafort, the yoga strand of Boise's Treefort Music Fest. At Esalen in Big Sur she teaches alongside the musician East Forest, pairing yoga, breathwork and meditation with his live sets. She also works one to one as a life coach and spiritual guide, and her students describe a warm, funny and grounded way of teaching.

courses.title: Journey Space: Music, Movement and Ceremony
courses.description: A four-day workshop at Esalen in Big Sur, Friday to Monday, co-led with the musician East Forest. She guides Self-Awakening Yoga, yin yoga and breathwork between his live performances, with meditation, journaling, group music-making and time outdoors.

courses.title: Ireland Retreat with Amanda Giacomini and Marisa Radha Weppner
courses.description: Five nights at the Cliffs of Moher Retreat in County Clare, taught together with Amanda Giacomini. Days combine yoga with coastal walks, visits to holy wells and stories from Celtic myth.

courses.title: Private Yoga, Meditation and Pranassage Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one sessions booked through her website, online or at her Boise studio. Options include an hour of private yoga, a half-hour guided meditation and a longer Pranassage session that combines assisted movement with bodywork.

courses.title: Online Classes on Udaya
courses.description: Recorded classes on the Udaya yoga platform, including several yin sessions, beginner flows and Self-Awakening Yoga. Access is through an Udaya membership, which has a free trial.

free_resources.title: Practice with Me
free_resources.description: A page of full-length yoga and meditation classes she shares for free, among them a mantra practice and a livestreamed class with East Forest's music. Donations are welcome but not required.

free_resources.title: Marisa Radha Weppner on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her teacher page on the free Insight Timer app, with guided meditations and classes.

free_resources.title: Love, Service, Wisdom Podcast
free_resources.description: Her podcast of conversations with teachers, musicians and seekers, plus solo talks on yoga philosophy and the spiritual path.

flags: A good part of her site is ketamine-assisted therapy (Boise Ketamine Clinic), Somatic Experiencing and trauma-focused coaching, whose pages name conditions; all of that is left out and the listing rests on her yoga, meditation and retreat work. A human may want to confirm she is not mainly a therapist.
radha@eastforest.org appears on her yoga page only as a PayPal payment address (on East Forest's domain), so it was not used; the contact form is the route.
Her Esalen programmes are co-led with East Forest (Trevor Oswalt, apparently her partner), who has his own queue entry (rank 205); possible overlap.
She has an Insight Timer teacher page (insighttimer.com/radha); Insight Timer was not added to teaches_at because it is not one of the listed sources for this sprint. A human may want to add it.
The Ireland retreat is co-led with Amanda Giacomini and booked through amandagiacomini.com; the price is from that booking page and some room types are sold out.
Private sessions price 'From $75 USD' is the 30-minute meditation; private yoga is $160 USD and Pranassage $200 USD (book-online page).
